visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair and a beige sweater sits at a wooden table in front of a yellow couch and white brick wall. She speaks animatedly, with pager icons showing numbers 555-3215, 1998, and 543-4800 floating near her. (2) The screen focuses on a gray pager icon with the number 1998 on a green screen. It then cuts to a screenshot of Google's company information page, with the founding date 1998 highlighted in red. (3) A different pager icon appears with the number 555-3215. The background is white. Text overlays discuss its origin as a common fictional number in the US. (4) A third pager icon shows the number 543-4800. The scene shifts to a screenshot of a legal document for Meta Platforms, Inc., highlighting a contact phone number ending in 543.4800. (5) The woman reappears, holding a smartphone to her ear and speaking with an exaggerated, frustrated expression. She ends the video by giving two thumbs up and pointing down to the comment section.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 呼叫器 Emoji 上的數字. (2) [Subtitle]: 居然是電話號碼？ (3) [Subtitle]: 各家呼叫器 Emoji 上的彩蛋, 你都知道嗎？ (4) [Subtitle]: 首先我們要先知道, 呼叫器其實是一個 BBcall. (5) [Subtitle]: 在手機還不普及的時候, BBcall 是大家通訊的好工具. (6) [Variety]: 1998. [Logo]: Google. (7) [Subtitle]: 不難看出它應該是個年份. (8) [Subtitle]: 實際上 1998 年就是 Google 公司成立的年份喔. (9) [Variety]: 555-3215. (10) [Subtitle]: 有人說這是蘋果公司的 BBcall 號碼. (11) [Subtitle]: 但它其實似乎只是一個虛構的號碼. (12) [Subtitle]: 555 是美國常用的虛構數字. (13) [Variety]: 543-4800. (14) [Subtitle]: 臉書的是 543-4800. (15) [Subtitle]: 它就真的是臉書美國總部的電話號碼了. (16) [Subtitle]: 網路還說你使用臉書遇到問題, 還可以撥打這支電話詢問喔. (17) [Subtitle]: 喂！你們家演算法到底是怎樣啊？ (18) [Subtitle]: 你還知道其他呼叫器的彩蛋嗎？歡迎底下留言分享喔！
